751-5434-6006.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1436-4324-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
1436-4324-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-4324-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Workshop Elders.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

401-2403-2530-3944.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2403-2530-3944.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

1981-2415-4050-6794.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2275-6980-7737.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2275-6980-7737.description:
Draw a card.
Shabraz and Stark's Ingenuity trigger for each card drawn.
Resolve all Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz for each trigger.
Resolve the first Stark's Ingenuity trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fetid Gargantua.
Fetid Gargantua triggers, causing you to draw two cards and lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.
2275-6980-7737.notes: With the additional Stark's Ingenuity trigger, you can target any creature you control to put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

2092-2757-5140-5633.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 4 power.
2092-2757-5140-5633.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Fleshbag Marauder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fleshbag Marauder enters, it triggers.
In response, activate Earthcraft by tapping Fleshbag Marauder, untapping the basic Swamp.
Resolve Fleshbag Marauder's ability, sacrificing it and causing each other player to sacrifice a creature.
Repeat.

2523-2869-4890.description:
Cast Dack's Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Dack's Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Dack's Duplicate dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Dack's Duplicate that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Dack's Duplicate token instead.
2523-2869-4890.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

3259-7060-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

206-2440-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
206-2440-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

1987-6991-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-6991-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Donnie & April.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

338-3490-4050-4476.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4050-4476.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

107-997-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3705-5075-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

628-1228-5571-6922.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch.
You control an additional nontoken non-Human creature that does not have indestructible or protection from red.
Your deck size is at least 2.
628-1228-5571-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Blightbeetle and causing you to draw a card.
Give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the additional creature and destroying it due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Goblin Sharpshooter trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Sharpshooter trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 4.

2457-4289-4772-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

Activate an artifact creature by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature.
Repeat.

997-4826-5003-6644.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

2178-2921-3817-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-2921-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

826-3562-3899-6243.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-3562-3899-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Sky Hussar.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sky Hussar.
When Sky Hussar dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

2719-5686-5756.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

862-5147-5220-5683.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Crimson Kobolds and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2084-3680.notablePrerequisites: Stunt Double is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-3680.description: Activate Stunt Double by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Stunt Double into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1339-3129-5349.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four tokens.
1339-3129-5349.description:
Activate Izoni by sacrificing four tokens, causing you to surveil 2, draw two cards, and gain 2 life.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with haste.
Repeat.

433-654-3756-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Llanowar Scout.
Llanowar Scout does not have summoning sickness.
433-654-3756-4222.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

1350-4377-5238.notablePrerequisites: Ethereal Forager does not have summoning sickness.
1350-4377-5238.description:
Declare Ethereal Forager as an attacker.
Ethereal Forager triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from exile to your hand.
Activate Termur Sabertooth by paying {2}{W}, returning Ethereal Forager to your hand from the battlefield.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ethereal Forager by paying {3}{U}{U} and exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

360-4186-4384.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-4186-4384.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

262-859-2999.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
262-859-2999.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Impassioned Orator four times.
Resolve the first Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1558-2988-5228.notablePrerequisites: Descent into Avernus has at least four descent counters on it.
1558-2988-5228.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Descent into Avernus triggers, putting two descent counters on it, then causing each player to create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of descent counters on Descent into Avernus, causing each opponent to be dealt an amount of damage equal to the number of descent counters on Descent into Avernus, and causing you to gain life equal to the number of descent counters on Descent into Avernus.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1048-2459-3652-3800-5283.notablePrerequisites: Iceberg has at least one ice counter on it.
1048-2459-3652-3800-5283.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Inexorable Tide and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Inexorable Tide trigger, putting an ice counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter, adding {C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Inexorable Tide and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Inexorable Tide trigger, putting an ice counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg's second ability by removing an ice counter, adding {C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2147-5003.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
2034-2147-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Company Commander, adding {C}{C}.
Company Commander dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Company Commander from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Company Commander enters the battlefield, creating at least two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

647-2178-4265.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Royal Assassin.
647-2178-4265.description:
Whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control, it enters tapped due to Urabrask.
Holding priority, activate Royal Assassin by tapping it, destroying the creature.
The creature dies, triggering Royal Assassin, untapping Royal Assassin.
Repeat.
